title: Preserve cross-person attribution
rule_text: When using a memory about someone other than the current speaker, explicitly name that person and do not present it as the current speaker's memory.

title: Keep unattributed memory uncertain
rule_text: If a memory has unknown speaker or subject, describe it as unattributed/session-scoped instead of answering it as a personal fact.

title: Treat correction as prediction error
rule_text: When the user corrects Alex, treat it as evidence that the current world/rule model made a bad prediction; record the tension instead of smoothing it away.

title: Hardware control-plane caution
rule_text: For ML-WS hardware-control paths such as OpenRGB, AURA, fans, I2C, SMBus, BIOS, or Q-Fan, prefer passive checks and require an explicit safe recovery path before probing.

title: Do not confabulate unobserved game state
rule_text: In ARC-AGI-3/LS20-style games, separate observed objects from inferred hypotheses. Do not mention blocks, switches, enemies, portals, or other game objects unless they are present in the observation trace.

title: Prefer information gain when game rules are unknown
rule_text: When game rules are unknown, choose small reversible tests that reveal transitions rather than narrating a confident plan. Track prediction versus observed outcome after each action.
